I am an old woman, 57 years, and I work this small maize plot of less than a quarter hectare here in Oromia. The land is ours, thanks be to God, but I have no schooling and must follow what my neighbors and the development agent say. I will try to get a little DAP and urea from the cooperative if it comes in time, and I save manure from our animals to put on the maize because the soil is getting tired. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year, so I will plant seed I kept from last harvest, and my children and grandchildren will help me weed — I have no money to hire people for such a small plot.
